correctness.rationale: For positive scales a,b, after scaling t=max/min>=1, the one-coordinate law of four sphere-coordinate uniforms gives exact cubic spline q_t. The 3->5->7 radial dimension walks generate unique signed p5,p7. Symbolic chamber integration and independent exact checks confirm normalization, second moment, and p7>=0 exactly through inclusive t=1+sqrt(3), with negative open interval beyond. At knot r=2t a positive upward p7 jump (2t/15 for t>1, 4/15 at t=1) violates the nonincreasing Abel-squared tail required of any nonnegative eight-dimensional spectral measure, excluding Phi8 and higher. p5 is nonnegative for every t via known Omega3² in Phi5 and Schur product; nonempty open spectral support gives strict PD on distinct configurations. This is an infinite proof by explicit radial density/Abel necessity, not finite tests.
